nodes.label: IslandBridgeCommandsTest.kt
IslandBridgeCommandsTest
.`boot asks the host for its payload`()
Test
.`boot payload carries the settings the island reads unconditionally`()
.`boot payload reports the screen in dp, because that is what the page lays out in`()
.`boot reports dp even when the density is not a round number`()
.`a broken density reports dp rather than dividing by zero`()
.`settings omit integrations the android host cannot poll`()
.`chat send carries the query exactly as typed`()
.`chat send rejects an empty query instead of guessing`()
.`chat reply is an object with text, which is what the view dereferences`()
.`chat reply survives quotes and newlines in the answer`()
.`island rect becomes a window sized to the island plus a margin`()
.`island rect ignores a payload it cannot trust`()
.`the window is the island rect, scaled from dp to px`()
.`the window is never wider than the screen, whatever the page asks for`()
.`window bounds track the island rect on both axes`()
.`window bounds survive a degenerate screen width and density`()
.`a window as wide as the screen is pinned to the origin`()
.`a small window keeps the position it was dragged to`()
.`a window dragged past the edge is pulled back onto the screen`()
.`an unmeasured window is only clamped at the origin`()
.`a window bigger than the screen does not get a negative origin`()
.`the drag handle is three commands, and carries a delta not a position`()
.`a drag delta the host cannot use is dropped rather than applied`()
.`a zero drag delta is still a drag, not a rejection`()
.`save settings is forwarded with the three card controls read`()
.`volume is clamped to the range the upstream player allows`()
.`settings that are not shaped like settings fall back to the defaults`()
.`focus window carries the flag the desktop app flips`()
.`collapse carries the flag`()
.`only web urls leave the overlay`()
.`the document request maps to the bundle root, not a doubled folder`()
.`root-absolute bundle urls are left alone`()
.`a bare directory request serves the document`()
.`a folder that merely starts like the prefix is not stripped`()
.`every url the shipped document requests resolves inside the bundle`()
.`the shipped document keeps the device-width viewport, so a css px is a dp`()
.`desktop-only commands answer null instead of failing`()
.`commands that are not JSON still answer null rather than throwing`()
.`envelopes are the shape the js shim expects`()
